beatLines.line: 🍽️ Half your share tonight. You hand the rest to Ella, who takes it with both hands and doesn't say a word until it's gone.
🍽️ You wave off the second scoop and nod toward Leo. 'Leo eats first tonight.' Nobody at the fire disagrees.
🍽️ Thin day. Your bowl stays half-full — the other half goes to Leo, who's been quiet about being hungry.
🍽️ Half your share tonight. You hand the rest to Leo, who takes it with both hands and doesn't say a word until it's gone.
🍽️ You push half your bowl across the fire to Leo — 'eat. You need it more than I do.' Leo doesn't argue. The bowl comes back scraped clean.
🍽️ The bins are thin, and Ella looks it. You set your second half in front of Ella. 'Eat,' you say. Ella eats like someone making up for days.
